cases.root_cause: IFSC syntax requires 5th char to be 0 (^[A-Z]{4}0[A-Z0-9]{6}$). Tesseract OCR recognized 0 as capital letter O with high confidence. Unconstrained verification accepted invalid IFSC without syntax or ambiguity check.
cases.remedy: Implement strict identifier syntax and glyph confusable validation. Flag O/0 ambiguity at index 4 of IFSC pattern and abstain under conservative policy.

cases.root_cause: OCR glyph confusion substituted 6 with 8 in year token, and trailing comma was not cleanly stripped, producing invalid date format.
cases.remedy: Enforce trailing punctuation stripping and date semantic validation.
